title: quotient derived unit
statement: On an essentially small site with a terminal object, sheafification and the usual abelian sheaf exactness assumptions, let n>0, G an abelian sheaf, H a sheaf of ULift(Z/n)-modules and U the coefficient-forgetting functor. If n:G→G followed by p:G→UH is short exact, then p satisfies DerivedUnit [def-sp-exact-functor-derived-unit], in any chosen unbounded derived categories.

source.place: Derived reduction, finite coefficient extension and canonical comparison paragraphs

proof.text: Realize raw module sheaves as modules over the constant residue ring and abelian sheaves as integer modules. Apply normalized divisible-extension reduction to the split presentation 0→G→G. Its quotient identification identifies the adjunction unit with p. Transport the Hom bijections along the integer-module and raw-module equivalences. Exact-functor single comparisons identify the transported map with single(p). The argument is valid for n=1 and zero sheaves.

theorem quotient_derived_unit [EssentiallySmall.{u + 1} C] [HasTerminal C]
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n)
    (F : Sheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (H : Sheaf J (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod n))))
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wAb} (Sheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wMod}
      (Sheaf J (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod n))))]
    [(sheafCompose J (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod n)))
      AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).Additive]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits (sheafCompose J
      (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod n))) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}))]
    [PreservesFiniteColimits (sheafCompose J
      (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod n))) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}))]
    (p : F ⟶ (sheafCompose J (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod n)))
      AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj H)
    (hp : (n • 𝟙 F) ≫ p = 0)
    (hP : (ShortComplex.mk (n • 𝟙 F) p hp).ShortExact) :
    (sheafCompose J (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod n)))
      AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).DerivedUnit F H p
